title: Coffered Domed Rotunda
purpose: Vertical hero and section-break imagery; aspiration motif.
story: Looking straight up into a coffered dome — the upward pull of institutional aspiration, geometry receding toward a faint oculus.
environment: The interior of a great dome seen from directly below, coffers diminishing toward a dim central oculus.
architecture: Classical dome interior — concentric rings of recessed coffers, a ringed cornice, an oculus glowing faintly at the apex.
composition: Perfectly symmetrical from below, coffers spiralling inward to the oculus, the faint warm glow at centre against deep shadow at the rim.
negativeExtra: any painted figures or text in the dome
continuityNotes: Matches the set's near-black grade and brass-on-black palette of scene-01; only the oculus carries the single warm source.
